newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stock market closed for national holiday.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stock market closed for national holiday.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market will be closed on Tuesday for a national holiday and will reopen on Wednesday.

On Monday, the key 225-share Nikkei average closed up 57.51 points or 0.31 percent at 18,670.37, after hovering within a limited range throughout the session. June Nikkei futures gained 20 points to end at 18,650.
The broader-based TOPIX index gave up 0.78 points or 0.06 percent to close at 1,410.85.
